import requests

cid = 11773
url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/{cid}/description/JSON"
r = requests.get(url)
print("Description response status:", r.status_code)
if r.status_code == 200:
    data = r.json()
    print(data)

synonyms_url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/{cid}/synonyms/JSON"
r_syn = requests.get(synonyms_url)
print("Synonyms response status:", r_syn.status_code)
if r_syn.status_code == 200:
    syns = r_syn.json()
    print("First 10 synonyms:", syns['InformationList']['Information'][0]['Synonym'][:10])

prop_url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/cid/{cid}/property/Title,IUPACName,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight/JSON"
r_prop = requests.get(prop_url)
print("Property response status:", r_prop.status_code)
if r_prop.status_code == 200:
    print(r_prop.json())
